title: Enrich mapped relationships with layer, status and dependencies
requirements:
- Show for each element whether it is foundational shared data layer, business-services layer, DPI-F dependency, operational application, or cross-cutting governance
- Indicate whether each relationship is core, supporting, optional, conditional or illustrative
- Indicate which capabilities must exist before others can be implemented, e.g. via a dependency matrix
- Distinguish authoritative entity registries from the longitudinal clinical record within the foundational layer
- Map goals to the specific component services needed rather than whole components where possible
- Mark capabilities as minimum REDDHI baseline, use-case-dependent, progressive enhancement or advanced target
- Include the principal operational application categories, kept outside the DPI-H boundary
- Apply one consistent relationship pattern (goal, outcome, capability, service, component, data object) across all goals
